newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks pare gains in late trading, curbs off.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks pare gains in late trading, curbs off.

text.p: U.S. stocks pared their gains in late trading on Friday.
Traders linked the move to volatility tied to the "triple witching" expiration of options and futures.
The Dow was up about 14 points to 7790. The New York Stock Exchange's lifted its curbs on index-arbitrage trades at 1534 EDT/1832 GMT. Losers led gainers by a seven to five ratio.
The Nasdaq composite was flat at 1446.
